address: 5F, THE ARCADE, 158 Dunhua North Road, Songshan District, Taipei, 105, Taiwan
bio: This long-standing Thai restaurant in an upmarket shopping mall is well known for its quality food. The beautifully appointed interior complete with an impressive sculpture befits its classy surroundings. To ensure authenticity, the kitchen of exclusively Thai chefs sources most spices and ingredients from their home country, including holy basil, turmeric and bird’s eye chillies. You can even specify the spiciness of some dishes.
